ft_base_rate_consistency.name: ft_base_rate_consistency
ft_base_rate_consistency.value: ("financial_transactions"."currency" = "financial_transactions"."base_currency" AND "financial_transactions"."base_amount" = "financial_transactions"."amount") OR ("financial_transactions"."currency" <> "financial_transactions"."base_currency" AND (("financial_transactions"."exchange_rate" IS NULL AND "financial_transactions"."base_amount" IS NULL) OR ("financial_transactions"."exchange_rate" IS NOT NULL AND "financial_transactions"."base_amount" IS NOT NULL)))
